description: Native JSON (`grype <sbom> -o json`) recorded once from Grype v0.120.1 and fed through the parser by the recorded tier of req-grype-corpus. Recorded by the rampart-pg session on 2026-10-15, then trimmed here to the fields the parser reads (descriptor name, version and db; per match the vulnerability id, severity, description, dataSource, fix, knownExploited and epss, the related vulnerability ids, and the artifact name, version, type and purl) and committed as plain JSON so a reviewer can read it. Every match is kept (91 and 21); values are unchanged. The live tier re-runs the real binary.

tap-web.grype-0.120.1.trimmed.json.input: the tap-web image SBOM (sha256:a9149a88..., 192 components) with the full purl, cpe and cpe candidates
